transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. Nice to meet you. Well, I guess what finally pushed me to make an appointment is that I just can’t seem to organize all the moving parts of my work and life anymore. 

Between patent notes, workshop prep, gallery deadlines, and everyday team decisions, there's just a lot going on. Instead of prioritizing, I just end up starting whatever is loudest in the moment, instead of focusing on what actually matters. It's really starting to become a problem.
Have you had problems with distractibility or organization since you were a child?

Yeah, looking back, this was definitely there in grade school, too. Long before I was even a teenager. 

My teachers used to write on my report cards that I was a bright kid, but that I daydreamed a lot. I would actually finish my assignments and then just... forget to turn them in. Or I'd completely lose my homework folders. So, yes, the distractibility and organization issues have been around since I was young.
